articleTitle: Drop-Off or Ease In? What Actually Works for Daycare Transitions at 12 Months
imageHeadline: Starting Daycare at 12 Months? The Transition Debate
imageSubtext: What research says about gradual vs. quick starts when separation anxiety peaks
pinTitle: Drop-Off or Ease In? What Actually Works for Daycare Transitions at 12 Months
pinDescription: Your toddler has separation anxiety and daycare is starting soon. Should you do a gradual transition or jump right in? We break down what the research actually shows about both approaches, plus what to expect when switching from home care to a center setting.
